title: The Cost of a Physics Prior Is Bounded by the Ablation Gap
abstract: arXiv:2608.21059v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Shape-constrained and physics-informed learning reports an accuracy cost of enforcing a prior and treats it as a property of the prior. We show it is mostly a property of the free features and the validation split. Let P be the excess risk of restricting a hypothesis class to functions with a shape constraint on features S, and D the excess risk of the ablated model that ignores S. Because a function constant in x_j is both non-decreasing and non-increasing in x_j, the ablated class is contained in the constrained class, so 0 <= P <= D for every risk functional, with no convexity, smoothness, or realizability assumption. Empirically the bound is a sign test: a constrained model must never be beaten by its own ablation. We instantiate it on an ordinal wildfire-severity task (N = 26,681, K = 3) with hard monotone constraints on four meteorological drivers, coordinates left free, and a validation ladder from i.i.d. resampling to 2-degree sp

translated_title: 物理先验的成本受消融差距限制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21059v1 公告类型：新 摘要：形状约束和物理信息学习报告了强制执行先验的准确性成本，并将其视为先验的属性。我们表明，这主要是自由特征和验证分割的属性。设P为将假设类限制为在特征S上具有形状约束的函数的超额风险，D为忽略S的消融模型的超额风险。由于在x_j上恒定的函数既是非递减的又是非递增的，消融类包含在约束类中，因此对于每个风险泛函，都有0 <= P <= D，无需凸性、平滑性或可实现性假设。经验上，该界限是一个符号检验：约束模型绝不能被其自身的消融模型击败。我们在一个序数野火严重程度任务（N=26,681，K=3）上实例化，对四个气象驱动因素施加硬单调约束，坐标保持自由，验证阶梯从独立同分布重采样到2度空间。
tldr: 论文证明物理先验的成本主要由自由特征和验证分割决定，而非先验本身，并提出一个简单界限和符号检验来验证约束模型的有效性。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the cost of a physics prior is mainly determined by free features and validation splits, not the prior itself, and proposes a simple bound and sign test to verify constrained models.
